system.description:
You take your weapon and coat it in your chakra, and use your raw skill to gauge the distance between yourself and your target.

Select a point you can see within range. All creatures within 5 feet of this point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

Additionally, you can choose to spend an additional 6 Chakra to use this jutsu again targeting the same point, forcing all creatures to repeat the saving throw. You can do this twice per casting.

Chain 2: Your Judgement is all encompassing and unmatched. Creatures who fail their saving throw also gain a rank of Bleed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, when you cast this jutsu, select a second point within range as you affect both areas simultaneously with this jutsu. A creature can only make saving throws vs this jutsu from a single affected area per casting.
